name: Makita
legalEntityNote: Makita Corporation is the Japanese listed parent. Makita U.S.A., Makita Corporation of America, regional subsidiaries, distributors and factories may each have different responsibilities for a product, contract and warranty.
headline: Makita ownership, cordless cleaning equipment and professional distribution network
description: A source-backed profile of Makita Corporation's listed-company structure, LXT and XGT cleaning equipment, global manufacturing network and professional-channel checks.
metaDescription: Makita profile: ownership, LXT and XGT vacuums and dust extraction, manufacturing, distributors and professional buyer checks.
disclaimer: World Clean Biz is an independent industry publication and is not affiliated with Makita. Corporate network statements do not establish the responsible factory or seller for every product SKU.

contentVisuals.caption: Makita's battery platforms compete in a market where tool families and regional availability need separate verification.
The professional tool category extends beyond drills into cleaning, dust management, outdoor equipment and storage workflows.
Buyer value comes from platform fit, accessory compatibility and service support rather than brand familiarity alone.

ownership.summary: Makita Corporation is a Japanese public company. Its corporate materials trace the business to 1915 and describe a global network of manufacturing and assembly plants, regional operations and professional distribution. Makita U.S.A. and other local companies should not be mistaken for the Japanese parent or for each other.

leadership.name: Mosaburo Makita
leadership.context: Makita's official company history dates the business to Mosaburo Makita's 1915 electric-motor sales and repair company.

productPortfolio.name: LXT 18V and 36V cordless tools
productPortfolio.positioning: A broad cordless ecosystem supporting tools, outdoor equipment and cleaning applications.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Confirm battery format, charge system, kit composition and regional electrical requirements.

productPortfolio.name: XGT 40V and 80V max systems
productPortfolio.positioning: Higher-output cordless platform for professional jobsite and outdoor applications.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Do not assume LXT and XGT interchangeability; verify tool, battery and charger compatibility.

productPortfolio.name: Cordless vacuums and dust management
productPortfolio.positioning: Portable vacuums, extractors and dust-control accessories integrated into professional workflows.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Match dust class, hose adapters, tool activation and applicable safety requirements.

productPortfolio.name: Outdoor equipment and professional accessories
productPortfolio.positioning: Adjacent equipment extends the platform into landscaping, construction and facilities use.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Validate dealer competence, service parts and local product approvals for the application.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Makita U.S.A. says the group operates ten manufacturing and assembly plants in eight countries.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Confirm origin, responsible manufacturer and compliance documentation for the exact SKU.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Makita's U.S. materials distinguish Makita U.S.A. distribution operations from Makita Corporation of America manufacturing and assembly in Georgia.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Identify the contracting, importing and warranty entity for the destination market.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: The Makita Report provides group-level corporate disclosure but does not assign all model families to a common factory.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Use current product labels, declarations and shipment records for origin claims.

marketsChannels.evidence: Makita says its U.S. network includes warehouse and distribution facilities plus innovation training centers for contractors and dealers.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Confirm authorized dealer status, service access and the relevant product program.

marketsChannels.evidence: Makita operates as a global brand in more than 40 countries.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Check country-specific availability, voltage and warranty before ordering.

marketsChannels.evidence: Professional distribution is supported by regional subsidiaries and dealer education.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Specify local sales, service and parts support in tender requirements.

competitivePosition.summary: World Clean Biz assessment: Makita's advantage is a large cordless platform combined with professional distribution and a global manufacturing footprint. For cleaning buyers, that becomes valuable where vacuums and extractors have to fit an installed battery ecosystem. The buyer-side discipline is configuration control: LXT, XGT, accessory and local-service choices are not interchangeable.
